categories.main_business_segments: Wuhu Token Sciences Co., LTD operates primarily in two main business segments: automotive electronics and consumer electronics. The automotive electronics segment includes vehicle sensors, sensor modules, 2D and 3D vehicle cover glass, display modules, and integrated touch-display modules for various car screens. The consumer electronics segment covers ultra-thin LCD panel thinning, ultra-thin glass cover plates (UTG and UFG), ITO conductive glass, VR display modules, smart wearable display modules, smartphone, notebook (NB), and tablet (PAD) display modules, light guide plates, and electronic paper driver substrates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced vacuum thin-film coating technology, chemical strengthening of ultra-thin glass, multi-layer optical film technology, precision photolithography, glass surface treatment, and integrated touch-display lamination techniques. It has developed proprietary processes for 3D curved automotive cover glass, electrochromic automotive rearview mirror glass, HUD (head-up display) curved reflective mirrors, and flexible OLED module encapsulation. The production includes automated, high-precision equipment for cutting, grinding, polishing, coating, thinning (down to 30 microns), and lamination, supporting high yield and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global customers in the consumer electronics and automotive electronics industries, including top-tier panel manufacturers such as Sharp, LGD, BOE, and smartphone brands like OPPO, Vivo, Huawei, Xiaomi, and Google. Automotive clients include major domestic and international car manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers such as BYD, NIO, Chery, Geely, Great Wall, Ford, Daimler, and Porsche. The products cater to high-end segments in smartphones, foldable devices, VR headsets, smart wearables, notebooks, tablets, and intelligent vehicle cockpits.
categories.geographic_coverage: Wuhu Token Sciences operates primarily in China with significant domestic production bases in Anhui, Chongqing, Guangdong, and Shenzhen. It has expanded overseas with a wholly-owned subsidiary and production facility in Vietnam to enhance global market responsiveness. The company’s customer base and sales cover both domestic and international markets, with nearly half of its revenue generated from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of key electronic components and modules such as ultra-thin glass substrates, touch sensors, display modules, and integrated touch-display assemblies. It provides vertically integrated solutions from glass thinning and coating to module assembly, serving as a critical supplier to panel makers, device manufacturers, and automotive OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes innovation in ultra-thin and flexible glass technologies (UTG and UFG), automotive electrochromic mirrors, HUD components, and advanced display modules including flexible OLED and microLED for VR. It emphasizes vertical integration, automation, and digital transformation to improve quality and cost competitiveness. R&D efforts focus on new materials, optical films, 3D curved glass, and intelligent cockpit displays, supported by a large and growing R&D team with over 2,200 personnel and substantial patent holdings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic materials and components, including ultra-thin glass substrates, touch sensors, and display modules. The company operates on a product sales model, supplying high-value-added components and integrated modules to consumer electronics and automotive manufacturers. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but these are supplementary to core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the automotive electronics segment, competitors include companies like Sunny Optical and Truly. In consumer electronics, competitors include Samsung in the UTG field and other domestic and international panel and module manufacturers. Wuhu Token Sciences holds a leading position domestically in glass thinning and UTG production, with recognized technology differentiation and a strong foothold in high-end markets. It is a key certified supplier to top global panel makers and device brands, maintaining a competitive edge through vertical integration and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB 11.06 billion in 2024, representing a 24.4% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 47.7% to RMB 356.8 million. Total assets reached RMB 16.23 billion, up 13.57% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability despite challenging market conditions, supported by expanding production capacity and new product commercialization. R&D investment increased to over RMB 510 million, about 4.6% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wuhu Token Sciences emphasizes its vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities, advanced proprietary technologies in ultra-thin and flexible glass, and comprehensive product portfolio spanning from raw materials to integrated modules. Its ability to provide customized 3D curved automotive cover glass and electrochromic mirror solutions, combined with high automation and quality control, differentiates it in the high-end automotive and consumer electronics markets. The company’s strong customer relationships with global leaders and its focus on innovation and cost efficiency underpin its competitive advantage and value proposition.
